description: This Dart source file implements the TransactionRepository class, which provides an asynchronous interface for CRUD operations, data retrieval, and aggregation methods for the 'transactions' table in a SQLite database. It encapsulates database interactions for transaction data in a Flutter application.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Singleton class providing CRUD operations and aggregations for transactions stored in an SQLite database, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, fetching, and calculating sums of transactions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction record into the database and returns the model with the assigned id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by its id; returns true if successful.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by id; returns true if a row was deleted.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a transaction by id; returns null if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions filtered by optional epoch millis range and category; ordered by date descending.

methods.name: sumAmountInRange
methods.description: Computes the sum of transaction amounts within a specified date range and optional category.

methods.name: sumByCategory
methods.description: Calculates total amounts grouped by category within a date range, returning a list of maps with category_id and total_amount.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all transactions from the table, useful for testing purposes.
